def_text: An autotrophic process during which living entities fix inorganic carbon and generate biomass in terrestrial biomes.

exact_synonym: marine net primary production|oceanic primary production

def_text: An autotrophic process during which living entities fix inorganic carbon and generate biomass in the marine benthic biome.
exact_synonym: benthic net primary production|benthic primary production
